g.title: BAT1
g.text: 11.1 V nominal, 12.6 V fully charged; exact battery is not selected.

g.title: W_BAT_LEADS
g.text: Battery-supplied leads; gauge and length TBD
Red and black are the planned polarity colors; verify the selected battery before connection.

g.title: J1_BAT
g.text: Exact polarized connector family is not selected.

g.title: J1_ROBOT
g.text: Exact polarized connector family is not selected.

g.title: W_P1_TRUNK
g.text: Owned 16 AWG silicone wire - P1 unfused battery trunk
Keep the unfused positive segment as short as practical; actual red/black stock and available length require inspection.

g.title: F1
g.text: Owned waterproof medium inline fuse holder
1 x #9 (Owned standard blade fuse from 80-piece kit)
Install nearest practical point to battery positive; use stripped wire and weatherproof the completed joins.

g.title: W_P1_FUSED_POS
g.text: Owned 16 AWG silicone wire - P1 fused positive

g.title: TB1_NEG
g.text: Use a separate piece from positive. Verify the intended three-port common topology before wiring.

g.title: W_P2_DRIVER
g.text: Owned 16 AWG silicone wire - P2 motor-driver branch

g.title: W_P5_DROK_IN
g.text: Owned 16 AWG silicone wire - P5 converter input branch

g.title: TB1_POS
g.text: Use one piece only if continuity proves all three selected ports are common; otherwise replace with a known-common 3-port lever connector.

g.title: DRV1
g.text: Land stripped 16 AWG copper directly in the supplied 5 mm screw terminal; do not tin wire compressed by the screw.

g.title: PS1
g.text: Land stripped 16 AWG input wire directly in the screw terminals. Exact-unit input rating and common-ground behavior require bench verification.

g.title: W_P6_PI_HEADER
g.text: Four owned Elegoo/Dupont jumper leads - P6 Pi power
Use two positive and two return leads of equal short length, at most about 12 inches. Cut/strip the DROK ends and use the correct mating ends at H1; reject on heat or voltage drop.

g.title: H1
g.text: 23 mm Pi GPIO extension; four used contacts shown
One header exposes these contacts through the M.2 HAT+ stack. Confirm actual fit, pin numbering, and jumper gender before power.

g.title: PI1
g.text: Power header below H1 and direct USB-A host port
Never connect USB-C power while the DROK header feed is connected.

g.title: CBL_P7_USB
g.text: P7 data-capable USB-A to micro-B cable
Carries Pi-Due power and bidirectional serial data; internal colors are diagram conventions, not field-wiring instructions.

g.title: DUE1
g.text: Connect to only one powered USB host.
